'''John John's New And Improved Death Star Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[John]]
* '''Published:''' 14 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Docking Bay 327|Premiere-D-deathstardockingbay327.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star: Docking Bay 327
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Death Star Docking Bay 327 John DS JohnsNew.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Everybody thinks stormtropers are for people who have sucky decks, not me.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

With an entire legion of my best troops and imperial academy training I can make all of my stormtrooers 5,5 making them alost invulnerable. Also with we have a prisoner and all wrapped up I can capture many rebel charactors.
